subtopics.content: Definition, history, career opportunities, products, indigenous pottery, pioneer artists
subtopics.objective: Understand the history and scope of ceramics; identify utilitarian/decorative products (bricks, tiles, vases, bowls)[cite: 108]; study indigenous pottery traditions (Ntonso, Pankrono)[cite: 108]; recognize Ghanaian pioneer contemporary ceramic artists and their contributions[cite: 108].

subtopics.content: Clays, glazes, colouring oxides, stains, and material preparation
subtopics.objective: Define clay formation and types (primary/kaolin, secondary/ball clay, earthenware, stoneware)[cite: 108]; test for plasticity, shrinkage, and firing temperatures[cite: 108]; prepare plastic and rough clay bodies[cite: 108]; study glazes, stains, and colouring oxides[cite: 108].

subtopics.content: Hand tools, major equipment, design and construction of tools
subtopics.objective: Identify, use, and maintain modeling tools, calipers, kidneys, sponges, and cutting wires[cite: 108]; understand operation/maintenance of kilns, potter's wheels, blungers, pug mills, ball mills, and spray booths[cite: 108]; construct basic ceramic tools and equipment[cite: 108].

subtopics.content: Drawing/designing, hand building, wheel work, casting, pressing, extrusion
subtopics.objective: Develop ideas through sketching, dimensioning, and CAD[cite: 108]; master hand-building methods (pinching, coiling, slabbing)[cite: 108]; perform wheel work (throwing, turning)[cite: 108]; execute casting, pressing, and extrusion forming processes[cite: 108].

subtopics.content: Decorative processes, drying, firing types, glazing techniques and defects
subtopics.objective: Apply decorative techniques (stamping, inlaying, incision, sgraffito, slip trailing, sprigging)[cite: 108]; execute open firing, bisque firing, and glost firing[cite: 108, 109]; prepare and apply glazes, and identify/correct glazing defects[cite: 109].

subtopics.content: Site finding, financing, branding, enterprise management, costing, exhibitions
subtopics.objective: Evaluate factors for establishing an enterprise (financing, licensing, quality control)[cite: 109]; manage pricing, packaging, and marketing[cite: 109]; plan and organize exhibitions[cite: 109]; address environmental sustainability (afforestation, energy conservation, land reclamation)[cite: 109].

topics.title: Professional Practices, Ethics, Museums and Galleries

subtopics.content: Healthy studio practices, portfolio, business plan, museum functions and structure
subtopics.objective: Maintain safe studio habits[cite: 109]; construct portfolios, business cards, and business plans[cite: 109]; define museum history, socio-economic importance, administrative structure, and cultural functions[cite: 109].
